AND AWARD DATED 27.01.2024 PASSED IN MVC NO.1025/2023 ON THE FILE OF THE XI ADDITIONAL DISTIRCT JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, BELAGAVI IN AWARDING THE COMPENSATION OF RS.28,12,750/- AND INTEREST AT RATE OF 6% FROM THE DATE OF PETITION AND MODIFIED BY ENHANCING TO AS PRAYED FOR, WITH 18%

Memo is placed on record.
Appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
